clue.text: Piece once fired hits some cattle

parts.note: to pot is to hit or shoot, so hits gives pots
a herd is a group of cattle

explanation.surface: Someone takes shots that strike a few cows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Piece once fired' sounds like a gun, but it is a fragment of pottery fired in a kiln long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: A potsherd is a broken fragment of baked earthenware, a piece of clay that was fired in antiquity.

clue.text: Bird turning up to get fine piece of fish

indicators.note: turning means the word up is read backwards

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencils
a fin is part of a fish

explanation.surface: A seabird flips upward to snatch a good bit of fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The puffin is a seabird with a colourful beak.

clue.text: VIP I caught going very red

indicators.note: the VIP word has caught I, holding it inside

parts.note: a titan is a very important, powerful person

explanation.surface: A dignitary, caught out, blushes deeply.
explanation.walkthrough: 'caught' puts I inside TITAN; 'going' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Titian is the bright reddish-auburn hair colour named after the Venetian painter.

clue.text: Husband short of employment to keep family?

parts.note: O is the short form of of, as in o'clock
use means employment
to hold is to keep

explanation.surface: A jobless husband looks after the family.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short of' looks like 'lacking', but gives O, the clipped 'of'.
explanation.definitionFit: A household is the people living together in one home, usually a family, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Amid waves, fish makes playfully smooth progress

indicators.note: amid means the fish's word sits within the waves' word

parts.note: rollers are long breaking waves
the skate is a flat fish

explanation.surface: A fish glides easily through the surf.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone on wheeled boots glides smoothly along for fun.

clue.text: Attractive but short no way acceptable — required tall and blonde

indicators.note: acceptable is read as able to accept, so the shortened word takes the other letters in
short means the word is cut by its last letter

parts.note: nice means pleasant or attractive
O is zero, nothing, no
RD is the abbreviation for road, a way

explanation.surface: A lonely-hearts ad rejecting short suitors and asking for someone tall and fair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' cuts NICE to NIC; 'acceptable' has NIC take in O and RD.
explanation.definitionFit: Tall stature and fair hair are the stereotyped looks of people from Scandinavia.

clue.text: University daughter's entered to excel

parts.note: OU is the Open University

indicators.note: entered means daughter goes into the word to

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for daughter; the 's reads as is

explanation.surface: A girl gets into university and does brilliantly.
explanation.definitionFit: To outdo is to surpass or do better than, as excel can mean.

clue.text: Vehement criticism of dreadful-sounding group of people

indicators.note: sounding means the word for dreadful is heard, not spelt

parts.note: dire means dreadful
a tribe is a group of people

explanation.surface: A harsh attack on a frightful-seeming bunch of people.
explanation.definitionFit: A diatribe is a bitter verbal attack or tirade.

clue.text: Contract initially offered by manager is thrilling writer

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of contract is taken

parts.note: a handler is one who manages, as with an agent

explanation.surface: A thriller author gets a deal from an agent.
explanation.walkthrough: Raymond Chandler wrote hard-boiled detective thrillers.
explanation.definitionFit: Raymond Chandler was the American author of thrillers featuring Philip Marlowe.

clue.text: Be wholly suitable? Only at times

parts.note: fit means suitable
fully means wholly

explanation.surface: A question about being completely appropriate, answered with a shrug.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done intermittently, in fits and starts, happens only now and then.

clue.text: A bad girl's back needing hard beds

indicators.note: back means the letters of a and the girl's word are read in reverse order

parts.note: a tart is a promiscuous woman; tart's here gives tarts

explanation.surface: A naughty girl has a sore back and needs firm mattresses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns A TARTS round as a whole.
explanation.definitionFit: Geological layers of rock are called beds, and rock is hard.

clue.text: Coming down by coach to where cargo's unloaded

parts.note: landing means coming down to earth
a stage is a stagecoach

explanation.surface: Getting off a coach at the dock where goods are discharged.
explanation.definitionFit: A landing stage is a platform where ships tie up to unload goods and passengers.

clue.text: Two of the Three Kings missing in this picture?

indicators.note: missing means two of the three strokes go absent, leaving just one

parts.note: III is three in Roman numerals
II is two in Roman numerals
the Three Kings are the Magi; each is a mage, a wise man

explanation.surface: A nativity painting in which two of the three wise men are absent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing' takes II from III, leaving I; with the other two Kings gone, a single MAGE remains. 'of the' and 'in this' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: An image is a picture or likeness; the question mark flags the playful nativity scene.

clue.text: Very taken with woman, lamented forgetting name

parts.note: Ena is a woman's name

indicators.note: forgetting means a letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: mourned means lamented

explanation.surface: A woman grieved so much she lost track of someone's name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'forgetting' drops N from MOURNED, leaving MOURED.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone smitten, besotted or in love is enamoured.

clue.text: View as talented, so worth entertaining?

parts.note: to consider is to regard or view as
able means talented

explanation.surface: Thinking someone gifted, and therefore worth having round as a guest.
explanation.walkthrough: Entertaining an idea is considering it, so the whimsical reading is 'able to be considered'.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally the word means fit to be thought about, as entertaining a notion means thinking about it.

clue.text: Abandoned any louder song

indicators.note: abandoned means wild and unrestrained, so the letters run riot

explanation.surface: Someone gives up any noisier singing.
explanation.definitionFit: A roundelay is a short simple song with a refrain.

clue.text: Grace warbles, singing from the heart

indicators.note: from the heart means the letters are taken from inside warbles singing

explanation.surface: Someone named Grace trills, singing with feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying grace is asking a blessing before a meal.

clue.text: Break during some Edinburgh performances

parts.note: in means during
the Fringe is the alternative part of the Edinburgh Festival, Scotland's arts festival

explanation.surface: A rule is broken during a show in Edinburgh.
explanation.definitionFit: To infringe a rule or law is to break it.

clue.text: June evenings may be so tedious

definitions.meaning: midsummer evenings stretch on with daylight lasting late
boring, going on far too long

explanation.definitionFit: Something long and protracted is both late-lit summer evenings and a tiresome affair.

clue.text: Turbulent boat journey to Caribbean island

indicators.note: turbulent means stirred up, so the letters of boat are mixed

parts.note: to go is to journey

explanation.surface: A rough sea crossing to an island in the West Indies.
explanation.definitionFit: Tobago is an island in the Caribbean, part of Trinidad and Tobago.

clue.text: Looked sound and gave best performance

indicators.note: sound means the word for looked is heard rather than seen

parts.note: these words are said aloud, and what is heard is the sound this part of the answer needs

explanation.surface: An athlete appeared healthy and was at their best.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Looked sound' reads as appeared healthy, but sound is the heard-alike signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To peak is to reach one's highest point of achievement.

clue.text: A place round which worry is taken off one's shoulders

indicators.note: worry goes round, so its word surrounds a and place

parts.note: stress means worry

explanation.surface: A spot where anxieties are lifted from someone's shoulders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken off one's shoulders' describes a dress style, not relief from worry; 'which' and 'is' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: A strapless dress has no straps going over the shoulders.

clue.text: Fish bird comes down on

definitions.meaning: a rod or branch where a bird alights

explanation.definitionFit: The word names a freshwater fish and a bird's roost.

clue.text: Bertie Wooster, say, is a boring speaker

definitions.meaning: P G Wodehouse's Bertie Wooster belongs to the ... Club, an idle young man's club in London
one who talks on in a monotonous hum

explanation.definitionFit: A member of the Drones Club is called a drone, and a monotonous talker drones on.

clue.text: Snub Italian ladies, having to leave first

indicators.note: the first letter is made to go from the word

parts.note: signore is the Italian plural for ladies

explanation.surface: Someone cold-shoulders some women from Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having to leave first' drops S from SIGNORE.
explanation.definitionFit: To snub someone is to pointedly disregard them.

clue.text: Genuine impression made by gospel on meeting-room

indicators.note: on means the gospel's word comes after the room's word

parts.note: a hall is a room for meetings
Mark is one of the four gospels

explanation.surface: A real mark left by a Bible on the floor of an assembly room.
explanation.definitionFit: A hallmark is the official stamp on precious metal, impressed to certify it is genuine.

clue.text: He got translated by English poet

indicators.note: translated means the letters of he got are turned into another form

explanation.surface: A man had his work rendered into English by a poet.
explanation.definitionFit: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe was the great German poet and dramatist.

clue.text: First rate? I'll go along with that

definitions.meaning: a phrase of agreement, as a butler might say

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means excellent and is also a formal reply of assent.
